behavior: Native sources from different clients transfer under receiving admission; same-owner sources share ownership and prepared reuse retains transferred input.
provider_decision: Reuse the existing bounded native payload copier and compact generated-range provider. No Arrow or Python-row bridge, source-session execution or new resource pool.
representation_boundary: Foreign native arrays may materialize into charged native buffers; columnar copy counts include value, offset and validity buffers. Cross-client transfers are not claimed as zero-copy or encoding-preserving.
